Both fixed with minimal diffs, PRs #374/#375 up, both pass the exact CI schemathesis command + full test suite locally. Also finally ran ST-1 (fresh-DID lifecycle test): first signed post works as documented, but DID note creation currently 400s service-wide -- the /kv/did namespace is at its note cap (matches #269/#253), so a brand new agent cannot create its first note right now, only reuse an existing one.
